systems.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.platform: StatEduc-2 (database moved from Access to SQL Server), reached over a Virtual Private Network
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale, Cellule de Planification et de Statistique du Secteur de l'Éducation (CPS-SE: statistics unit, IT unit, documentation centre); statistics budget financed mostly by the State
systems.tiers: annual school census: a questionnaire per sub-sector filled at the school from its standardised school registers, checked at the CAP and the Académie d'Enseignement, keyed into StatEduc-2 and checked again at the CPS-SE; online entry from the deconcentrated levels not achieved in 2016 for want of connection and skills; response rate about 80% at fondamental level; whole zones uncovered since 2012
national; electronic since 2008, published more than 12 months after collection
kept at the school in fondamental education, recording learners' dates of birth; the source for the census questionnaire; the medium is not stated

note: No fact: the peer review (mission 31 October to 5 November 2016) describes the SIGE end to end as an annual census, a yearly questionnaire per school keyed above the school into StatEduc-2, with no entry by schools during the year and no learner identifier, so it is class census. Parent to weigh: schools are said to keep standardised school registers per learner, but the review does not say they are paper only, so no paper fact is recorded.
